definitions.explanation: Working for oneself rather than being employed by a company. Encompasses freelancers, shop owners, and independent professionals.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{自営業|じえいぎょう}をしている。
examples.english: My father runs his own business.

examples.japanese: {自営業|じえいぎょう}は{収入|しゅうにゅう}が{不安定|ふあんてい}になりがちだ。
examples.english: Self-employment tends to bring unstable income.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}を{辞|や}めて{自営業|じえいぎょう}を{始|はじ}めたいと{思|おも}っている。
examples.english: I'm thinking of quitting my company job and starting my own business.

notes:
USAGE:
A self-employed person is called {自営業者|じえいぎょうしゃ}. On official forms, {自営業|じえいぎょう} is a standard category under occupation ({職業|しょくぎょう}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自営業|じえいぎょう}を{営|いとな}む (to run one's own business)
- {自営業者|じえいぎょうしゃ} (self-employed person)
- {自営業|じえいぎょう}を{始|はじ}める (to start one's own business)
